## Frequently Asked Questions about villa rentals in Marbella

- What are the best activities in Marbella?



There are so many great things to do in Marbella! Of course, you can't beat spending a day at the beach. Marbella has some of the best beaches in Spain, with soft sand and crystal-clear water. For a little excitement, try jet skiing or parasailing. And for a more relaxing experience, head to one of the many beach clubs and enjoy a delicious meal with a view.

- What are the best villa rentals in Marbella?





Among the villa rentals in Marbella, [Alojamientos Monteverde](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1257535), [La Casita By Teresa](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1050307) and [Golfers & Beach Villa With Heated Pool](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/11030376) are the most popular ones.

- What are the advantages of renting a house or a villa in Marbella



Renting a villa in Marbella can be a great way to experience the city like a local. You'll have more space and privacy than a hotel, and you can often find villas with private pools and gardens. This is especially great for families or groups of friends, as you can have your own space to relax and enjoy each other's company.

- What are the best villa rentals with a pool in Marbella?





[Alojamientos Monteverde](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1257535), [Golfers & Beach Villa With Heated Pool](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/11030376) and [Villa Marina](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1074930) are the best villa rentals with a pool in Marbella.

- What food festivals or culinary events take place in and around Marbella?



Marbella hosts several food festivals throughout the year, celebrating the region's delicious cuisine. The most popular is the Feria de San Bernabé in June, which features traditional Andalusian food and music. There's also the Marbella Gastronomy Week in October, which showcases the best restaurants in the city.

- What are the best villa rentals with a jacuzzi in Marbella?





The best villa rentals with a jacuzzi in Marbella are [Villa Marina](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1074930), [Luxury Sea View Villa - Hotel Size Pool - 2 Minutes Puerto Banus - Heated Jacuzzi](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1785785) and [Villa El Mirador](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/23615380).

- What exclusive experiences are available when visiting Marbella?



For a truly luxurious experience, you can book a private yacht charter and explore the stunning coastline. Or, if you're a golf enthusiast, you can play at one of Marbella's world-class golf courses. For a more unique experience, take a private cooking class and learn how to prepare some of the region's most famous dishes.

- What are the best villa rentals for families and kids in Marbella?





The best villa rentals for families and kids in Marbella are [Alojamientos Monteverde](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1257535), [La Casita By Teresa](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1050307) and [Golfers & Beach Villa With Heated Pool](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/11030376).

- Which part of Marbella would be ideal for a villa rental?



The Golden Mile is a popular area for villa rentals, as it's close to the beach and all the action. If you're looking for something a bit quieter, the area around Nueva Andalucia is a good choice. For a more traditional experience, you could rent a villa in the Old Town.

- What are the best pet friendly villa rentals in Marbella?





The best pet friendly villa rentals in Marbella are [La Casita By Teresa](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1050307), [Villa Marina](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1074930) and [Luxury Sea View Villa - Hotel Size Pool - 2 Minutes Puerto Banus - Heated Jacuzzi](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1785785).

- What are the best villa rentals with parking in Marbella?





[Alojamientos Monteverde](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1257535), [La Casita By Teresa](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/1050307) and [Golfers & Beach Villa With Heated Pool](https://www.cozycozy.com/us/marbella-villa-rentals#cp:details/11030376) are the best villa rentals with parking in Marbella.
